author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক modifier বসাও (Board: use of modifiers, 0.5×10)।

items.rule_bn: Noun (boy)-এর আগে adjective modifier বসে: intelligent।
Verb (runs)-কে বর্ণনা করতে adverb modifier বসে: fast।

items.q: ___ walking on the road, I met a friend. (While)
The girl, ___ in silk, looked gorgeous. (dress)
items.rule_bn: Noun-এর পরে past participle modifier বসে: dressed in silk।

items.q: ___ by a snake, he fell down. (Bite)
items.rule_bn: শুরুতে past participle modifier: Bitten by a snake, ...।
Singular noun (student)-এর আগে determiner modifier 'Every' বসে।

items.q: Choose the sentence with the modifier in the right place:
opts: Barking the dog chased the cat.
The dog chased the cat barking.
Barking loudly, the dog chased the cat.
items.rule_bn: Participle modifier যাকে বর্ণনা করে তার কাছে বসে: Barking loudly, the dog...।
Article + intensifier + adjective ক্রম: a very beautiful।
